title: docc document
description: A docc source document: one JSON file in docs/src. The id is the file name without extension. Extra free fields are allowed.

$schema.description: Path to a kind schema, for editor autocompletion; ignored by docc.

status.description: Allowed values are set by the kind schema.

body.description: Main text: a string or an array of paragraphs, printed right under the title.

notes.description: Hidden notes for agents; printed only by the audit build (build --full).

hidden.description: true: checked but not printed to out/.

reviewed.description: Confirmed links: target id to the 8-hex fingerprint of the target when it was checked.

docIgnore.description: Suppressions; every entry needs a reason.
